## AV-1 Overview and Summary Information

| Field | Value |

| Architecture | Rescue |

## CV-1 Vision

| Capability | Description | Vision |
| --- | --- | --- |
| RescueCapability | Recover people in distress quickly. | Every call is answered within one minute. |
| DispatchCapability | Assign the nearest team. | No call is left waiting. |
| LocateCapability | Find the position of the caller. | Position known within 50 metres. |
